body.label: Target
body.html: Up to three creatures in a cone of length 4.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, push each enemy 2 units. Willing targets instead move up to 2 units in a chosen direction without opposition.

surges.html: Increase one target's movement by 1 unit.
One hit enemy takes 1 Force Damage; willing targets gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn instead.

rider.title: Air Thread
rider.html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.
